::: {#hero-heading}
I am a Data Analyst at [Research Data Scotland (RDS)](https://www.researchdata.scot/about-rds/our-people/){target="_blank"} and a Doctoral Researcher at the [School of Health and Social Care, Edinburgh Napier University](https://www.napier.ac.uk/about-us/our-schools/the-school-of-health-and-social-care){target="_blank"}. My work and research bring together population and health data science, nursing and midwifery workforce research, and data stewardship.

I am undertaking a [PhD in Health and Social Care](https://www.napier.ac.uk/research-and-innovation/doctoral-college/phd){target="_blank"}. My project, [Using Nationally Representative Data to Understand the Nursing and Midwifery Professions in the United Kingdom](https://www.findaphd.com/phds/project/using-nationally-representative-data-to-understand-the-nursing-and-midwifery-professions-in-the-united-kingdom-shsc0061/?p184975){target="_blank"}, uses linked administrative and population data to inform workforce planning and policy. Within this research, I have a particular interest in internationally trained professionals and their contribution to the UK health workforce. View my [Researcher Profile at Edinburgh Napier University](https://napier-repository.worktribe.com/person/5283799/linus-chirchir/outputs){target="_blank"}.

At RDS, my work spans data preparation, metadata, synthetic data, reproducible analytical pipelines within Trusted Research Environments (TREs) and data stewardship. I help make complex administrative and health-related datasets easier to understand and use for research. Read more about my background in my [five-minute profile interview with RDS](https://www.researchdata.scot/news-and-insights/five-minute-profile-interview-with-linus-chirchir/){target="_blank"}.

I also lead [FRAME-DS: Framework for Recognising Applied Data Stewardship Within TRE Workforces - A Collaborative, Cross-Organisation Pilot](https://casdar.ac.uk/announcing-the-results-of-casdars-funding-call-round-1/){target="_blank"}, a project funded through [CaSDaR Network+](https://casdar.ac.uk/about/){target="_blank"} (Careers and Skills for Data-driven Research) to develop a framework and toolkit for recognising and supporting applied data stewardship within TRE workforces.
:::
